title: AudioFrame
description: One 250 ms PCM audio frame in transit between the ws-audio-ingest Lambda and the asr Lambda via the SQS audio-queue. The frame is the raw output of the offscreen capture in the browser extension: contiguous (non-overlapping) Int16 little-endian PCM at 16 kHz mono.

connectionId.description: API Gateway WebSocket connection ID identifying the originating client session. Used downstream to push transcripts and sign IDs back to the same client.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-session frame sequence number, starting at 0 when capture begins. Allows the asr Lambda to detect gaps and ordering issues.

language.description: Target sign language at the time of capture. The asr Lambda is language-agnostic for input (audio is always English) but tags the transcript so text-to-gloss picks the correct dictionary.

frame.description: Base64-encoded Int16 little-endian PCM. Exactly 4000 samples (8000 bytes) representing 250 ms at 16 kHz mono.

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp recorded by the client at the moment the frame was emitted. Used for end-to-end latency measurement.
